## Summary of the Results {.tabset}

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

data_dir <- "sim_results"
file_list <- list.files(path = data_dir, pattern = "res_scen_.*_chunk_.*\\.rds",
                        full.names = TRUE)

raw_sim_data <- file_list %>% map_dfr(readRDS)

summary_stats <- raw_sim_data %>%
 select(-starts_with("pt_cov_")) %>%
 group_by(n, sigma_true, K, Alpha_Setting, Method) %>%
 summarise(
  Reps = n(),
  Failures = sum(Failed, na.rm = TRUE),
  Mean_RMSE = mean(RMSE, na.rm = TRUE),
  Empirical_Coverage = mean(Coverage, na.rm = TRUE),
  
  Bias_Sigma = mean(Bias_Sigma, na.rm = TRUE),
  Cov_Sigma = mean(Cov_Sigma, na.rm = TRUE),
  
  # ratio of the estimated $\tau^2$ to the Oracle $\tau^2$
  Mean_Tau2_Ratio = mean(Tau2_Est / (Tau2_Est - Bias_Tau2), na.rm = TRUE),
  
  Bias_Tau2 = mean(Bias_Tau2, na.rm = TRUE),
    Cov_Tau2 = mean(Cov_Tau2, na.rm = TRUE),
  
  Bias_Alpha_1 = mean(Bias_Alpha_1, na.rm = TRUE),
  Cov_Alpha_1 = mean(Cov_Alpha_1, na.rm = TRUE),
  Bias_Alpha_2 = mean(Bias_Alpha_2, na.rm = TRUE),
  Cov_Alpha_2 = mean(Cov_Alpha_2, na.rm = TRUE),
  Bias_Alpha_3 = mean(Bias_Alpha_3, na.rm = TRUE),
  Cov_Alpha_3 = mean(Cov_Alpha_3, na.rm = TRUE),
  Bias_Alpha_4 = mean(Bias_Alpha_4, na.rm = TRUE),
  Cov_Alpha_4 = mean(Cov_Alpha_4, na.rm = TRUE),
  
  Avg_Time_Sec = mean(Time, na.rm = TRUE),
  .groups = "drop"
 ) %>%
 arrange(K, n, sigma_true, factor(Method, 
                                  levels = c("Oracle", "Naive", "ELE_n1_5",
                                             "ELE_n1_2", "ELE_GCV", "ELE_REML",
                                             "Gibbs", "VB")))

table_function_est <- summary_stats %>%
 select(K, n, sigma_true, Alpha_Setting, Method, Mean_RMSE, Empirical_Coverage, Avg_Time_Sec) %>%
 mutate(
  Mean_RMSE = sprintf("%.4f", Mean_RMSE),
  Empirical_Coverage = sprintf("%.3f", Empirical_Coverage),
  Avg_Time_Sec = sprintf("%.2f", Avg_Time_Sec)
 )

table_variance_comp <- summary_stats %>%
 select(K, n, sigma_true, Alpha_Setting, Method, Bias_Sigma, Cov_Sigma, Mean_Tau2_Ratio, Bias_Tau2, Cov_Tau2) %>%
 filter(!Method %in% c("Oracle", "Naive") | !is.na(Bias_Sigma)) %>%
 mutate(
  Bias_Sigma = ifelse(is.na(Bias_Sigma), "-", sprintf("%.4f", Bias_Sigma)),
  Cov_Sigma = ifelse(is.na(Cov_Sigma), "-", sprintf("%.3f", Cov_Sigma)),
  Mean_Tau2_Ratio = ifelse(is.na(Mean_Tau2_Ratio), "-", sprintf("%.3f", Mean_Tau2_Ratio)),
  Bias_Tau2 = ifelse(is.na(Bias_Tau2), "-", sprintf("%.4f", Bias_Tau2)),
  Cov_Tau2 = ifelse(is.na(Cov_Tau2), "-", sprintf("%.3f", Cov_Tau2))
 )

table_alpha_K1 <- summary_stats %>%
 filter(K == 1, Method %in% c("Gibbs", "VB", "ELE_n1_5", "ELE_n1_2", "ELE_GCV", "ELE_REML")) %>%
 select(n, sigma_true, Alpha_Setting, Method, Bias_Alpha_1, Cov_Alpha_1) %>%
 mutate(across(starts_with("Bias"), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), "-", sprintf("%.4f", .))),
        across(starts_with("Cov"), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), "-", sprintf("%.3f", .))))

table_alpha_K4 <- summary_stats %>%
 filter(K == 4, Method %in% c("Gibbs", "VB", "ELE_n1_5", "ELE_n1_2", "ELE_GCV", "ELE_REML")) %>%
 select(n, sigma_true, Alpha_Setting, Method, starts_with("Bias_Alpha"), starts_with("Cov_Alpha")) %>%
 mutate(across(starts_with("Bias"), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), "-", sprintf("%.4f", .))),
        across(starts_with("Cov"), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), "-", sprintf("%.3f", .))))

table_failures <- summary_stats %>%
 mutate(Failures_Report = paste0(Failures, " / ", Reps)) %>%
 select(K, Alpha_Setting, n, sigma_true, Method, Failures_Report) %>%
 arrange(K, Alpha_Setting, n, sigma_true)
```

### Tables {.tabset}

#### Spline Function Estimation & Run Time {.tabset}

##### (Single Block, K=1) {.tabset}

```{r results='asis'}
for(a in unique(table_function_est$Alpha_Setting[table_function_est$K == 1])) {
  cat("###### Alpha Setting: ", a, "\n\n")
  
  out <- table_function_est %>%
    filter(K == 1, Alpha_Setting == a) %>%
    select(-K, -Alpha_Setting) %>%
    kbl(align = "c", col.names = c("n", "Sigma", "Method", "Mean RMSE", "Coverage", "Time (sec)")) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "bordered"), full_width = FALSE, font_size = 12) %>%
    collapse_rows(columns = 1:2, valign = "middle")
    
  cat(out, "\n\n")
}
```

#### Point-wise Coverage {.tabset}

There are two plots below (including or excluding the naive approach).

##### Single Block, K=1 (Overall) {.tabset}

```{r results='asis', fig.height=9, fig.width=12}
coverage_profile <- raw_sim_data %>%
 group_by(K, n, sigma_true, Alpha_Setting, Method) %>%
 summarise(across(starts_with("pt_cov_"), mean), .groups = "drop") %>%
 pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("pt_cov_"), 
              names_to = "grid_idx", 
              values_to = "coverage") %>%
 mutate(
  grid_idx = as.numeric(gsub("pt_cov_", "", grid_idx)),
  x = (grid_idx - 1) / 199,
  Scenario = factor(paste0("n=", n, "\nSigma=", sigma_true)),
  Method = factor(Method, levels = names(method_colors)),
  Alpha_Setting = as.factor(Alpha_Setting)
 )

for(a in unique(coverage_profile$Alpha_Setting[coverage_profile$K == 1])) {
  cat("###### Alpha Setting: ", a, "\n\n")
  
  p <- ggplot(coverage_profile %>% filter(K == 1, Alpha_Setting == a), aes(x = x, y = coverage, color = Method)) +
   geom_hline(yintercept = 0.95, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray30") +
   geom_line(alpha = 0.8, linewidth = 0.8) +
   facet_wrap(~ Scenario, ncol = 4) +
   scale_color_manual(values = method_colors) +
   theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
   theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.box = "vertical") +
   labs(title = paste("Point-wise 95% Coverage Probability (Alpha =", a, ")"),
        x = "x",
        y = "Empirical Coverage",
        color = "Method") +
   coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.0, 1.0))
   
  print(p)
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

#### RMSE vs. $\sigma_*$ 

```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=12}
cross_data <- summary_stats %>%
 mutate(
  Scenario = factor(paste0("K=", K, ", n=", n, "\nAlpha=", Alpha_Setting)),
  Method = factor(Method, levels = names(method_colors)),
  sigma_true_factor = factor(sigma_true)
 )

ggplot(cross_data, aes(x = sigma_true_factor, y = Mean_RMSE, 
                             color = Method, group = Method, shape = Method)) +
 geom_line(linewidth = 1.2, alpha = 0.8) +
 geom_point(size = 3.5) +
 
 facet_wrap(~ Scenario, ncol = 3, scales = "free_y") +
 
 scale_color_manual(values = method_colors) +
 scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 17, 15, 18, 3, 4, 8, 21)) + 
 
 theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
 theme(
  legend.position = "bottom",
  legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
  legend.key.width = unit(2, "cm"), 
  strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90", color = "black"),
  strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
  axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1) 
 ) +
 
 labs(
  title = "RMSE by Noise Level",
  x = expression(paste("True (", sigma["*"], ")")),
  y = "Mean RMSE",
  color = "Method",
  shape = "Method"
 )
```

## Appendix {.tabset}

### HPC Script

```{bash eval = FALSE, class.source="fold-show"}
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=spline_sim
#SBATCH --output=logs/sim_%A_%a.out
#SBATCH --error=logs/sim_%A_%a.err
#SBATCH --array=1-400              
#SBATCH --time=01:00:00            
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=1          
#SBATCH --mem=2G                   
#SBATCH --partition=standard

module load goolf R

mkdir -p logs
mkdir -p sim_results

Rscript Spline_Simulations.R
```

### R Script

```{r eval = FALSE, class.source="fold-show"}
# ******************************************************************************
# Spline Regression with Mismatch Error
# ******************************************************************************
.libPaths("~/R/hpc_libs")

library(mgcv)
library(MASS)
library(Matrix)

# 1. ELE Permutation Helpers (Model II)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# random permutation with no fixed point (zero diagonal entries)
get_perm <- function(n_items) {
 if (n_items == 0) return(integer(0))
 if (n_items == 1) return(1) 
 x <- 1:n_items
 while (TRUE) {
  px <- sample(x)
  if (all(px != x)) return(px)
 }
}

# 2. Simulation Configuration & Grid
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
N_REPS <- 1000

# Define scenarios (K=1 block and K=4 blocks)
scenarios <- list()

for (n in c(500, 2000)) {
 for (sigma in c(0.1, 0.25, 0.75, 1, 1.25)) {
  # K = 1 scenarios
  for (a in c(0.05, 0.15, 0.3)) {
   scenarios[[length(scenarios) + 1]] <- list(
    n = n, sigma = sigma, K = 1, alphas = a
   )
  }
  # K = 4 scenario 
  scenarios[[length(scenarios) + 1]] <- list(
   n = n, sigma = sigma, K = 4, alphas = c(0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3)
  )
 }
}

eval_grid <- data.frame(x = seq(0, 1, length.out = 200))
true_f_eval <- sin(1.5 * pi * eval_grid$x)

# 3. Data Generation Process (w/ Block Permutation Logic)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
generate_data <- function(n, sigma, K, alphas, rep_id, global_seed) {
 base_seed <- rep_id * 10000 + n + K * 100 + as.integer(sigma * 100)
 set.seed(base_seed)
 
 # Generate true X equally spaced
 x <- seq(0, 1, length.out = n)
 
 # Randomly assign records to K blocks 
 Block <- sample(rep(1:K, each = n/K))
 
 # Generate True Signal and True Y
 f_true <- sin(1.5 * pi * x)
 Y <- rnorm(n, f_true, sigma)
 z <- rnorm(n, 0, 1)
 
 M <- c(table(Block)) # block sizes
 Ystar <- numeric(n)
 m_true <- numeric(n)
 
 set.seed(global_seed)
 
 # Permute Y to get Ystar (with linkage errors via Model II)
 for(q in 1:K) {
  idx <- which(Block == q)
  mq <- M[q]
  
  n_mismatch <- round(mq * alphas[q])
  
  if(n_mismatch > 0) {
   mis_idx_relative <- sample(1:mq, n_mismatch)
   perm_relative <- mis_idx_relative[get_perm(n_mismatch)]
   
   y_block <- Y[idx]
   y_shuffled <- y_block
   y_shuffled[mis_idx_relative] <- y_block[perm_relative]
   
   Ystar[idx] <- y_shuffled
   m_true[idx[mis_idx_relative]] <- 1 # m_i = I(Pi_ii != 1)
  } else {
   Ystar[idx] <- Y[idx]
  }
 }
 
 ord <- order(Block)
 
 list(x = x[ord], y_obs = Ystar[ord], y_true = Y[ord], z = z[ord], 
      blocks = Block[ord], m = m_true[ord], f_true = f_true[ord])
}

# 4. Model Estimation Wrappers
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
build_Q_matrix <- function(n, K, blocks, alphas) {
 Q_list <- lapply(1:K, function(k) {
  nk <- sum(blocks == k)
  ak <- alphas[k]
  if (ak == 0) return(diag(nk))
  (1 - ak - ak/(nk - 1)) * diag(nk) + (ak/(nk - 1)) * matrix(1, nk, nk)
 })
 as.matrix(bdiag(Q_list))
}

# ELE Approach
fit_ele <- function(dat, K, alphas, sp_choice, sigma_true, eval_grid) {
 n <- length(dat$y_obs)
 
 gam_naive <- gam(y_obs ~ s(x, bs="cr", k=25), data = dat)
 gamobj <- gam(y_obs ~ s(x, bs="cr", k=25, fx=FALSE), data = dat, fit = FALSE)
 
 X <- as.matrix(gamobj$X)[, -1] 
 xc <- dat$x - mean(dat$x)
 
 P <- gamobj$smooth[[1]]$S[[1]]
 svdP <- svd(P)
 rankthres <- 1e-8
 rankP <- sum(svdP$d > rankthres)
 Rinv <- svdP$v[, 1:rankP] %*% diag(1/sqrt(svdP$d[1:rankP])) %*% t(svdP$u[, 1:rankP])
 
 Q <- build_Q_matrix(n, K, dat$blocks, alphas)
 Qxc <- Q %*% xc
 QX <- Q %*% X
 
 Z_Q <- residuals(lm(QX ~ Qxc))
 Z_Qtilde <- Z_Q %*% Rinv
 
 svdZ <- svd(Z_Qtilde)
 rankZ <- sum(svdZ$d > rankthres)
 VQr <- svdZ$v[, 1:rankZ]
 DQr <- svdZ$d[1:rankZ]
 UQr <- svdZ$u[, 1:rankZ]
 
 ypermtilde <- residuals(lm(dat$y_obs ~ Qxc))
 
 if (is.character(sp_choice)) {
  ele_dat <- data.frame(y_tilde = as.numeric(ypermtilde))
  ele_dat$Z <- Z_Qtilde
  
  mgcv_method <- ifelse(sp_choice == "GCV", "GCV.Cp", "REML")
  mgcv_fit <- gam(y_tilde ~ -1 + Z, 
                  data = ele_dat, 
                  paraPen = list(Z = list(diag(1, ncol(Z_Qtilde)))), 
                  method = mgcv_method)
  
  sp <- as.numeric(mgcv_fit$sp)
 } else if (is.numeric(sp_choice)) {
  sp <- sp_choice
 } else {
  stop("Invalid sp_choice provided.")
 }
 
 L <- solve(crossprod(Z_Qtilde) + sp * diag(1, ncol(Z_Qtilde)))
 alphahat <- L %*% crossprod(Z_Qtilde, ypermtilde)
 
 alphahat_db <- alphahat + sp * drop(VQr %*% (drop(crossprod(VQr, alphahat)) / (DQr^2 + sp)))
 betahat_db <- Rinv %*% alphahat_db
 
 # Based on (Eq 12) 
 tilde_f <- as.numeric(X %*% betahat_db - 
                        xc * drop(crossprod(Qxc, QX %*% betahat_db)) / sum(Qxc^2) + 
                        xc * coef(lm(dat$y_obs ~ Qxc))[2] + 
                        mean(dat$y_obs))
 
 rss <- sum((dat$y_obs - tilde_f)^2)
 penalty_term <- 2 * sum(tilde_f * (as.numeric((diag(n) - Q) %*% tilde_f)))
 
 sig2_est <- (rss - penalty_term) / n
 sig2_est <- max(sig2_est, 1e-6)
 
 X_eval <- predict(gam_naive, newdata = eval_grid, type = "lpmatrix")[, -1]
 xc_eval <- eval_grid$x - mean(dat$x)
 
 f_est <- as.numeric(X_eval %*% betahat_db - 
                      xc_eval * drop(crossprod(Qxc, QX %*% betahat_db)) / sum(Qxc^2) + 
                      xc_eval * coef(lm(dat$y_obs ~ Qxc))[2] + 
                      mean(dat$y_obs))
 
 D <- numeric(n)
 for (i in 1:n) {
  k <- dat$blocks[i]
  ak <- alphas[k]
  if(ak > 0) {
   idx_k <- which(dat$blocks == k)
   mu_k <- tilde_f[idx_k] 
   i_in_k <- which(idx_k == i)
   
   mu_i <- mu_k[i_in_k]
   mu_m_i <- mu_k[-i_in_k]
   
   D[i] <- ((1-ak) - (1-ak)^2)*mu_i^2 + ak*mean(mu_m_i^2) - 
    ak^2*mean(mu_m_i)^2 - 2*ak*(1-ak)*mu_i*mean(mu_m_i)
  }
 }
 
 A <- VQr %*% diag(sp / (DQr^2 + sp)) %*% t(VQr)
 A <- A + diag(1, nrow(A))
 
 Xtilde_eval <- X_eval - (as.matrix(xc_eval) %*% crossprod(Qxc, QX)) / sum(Qxc^2)
 
 A_mat <- Xtilde_eval %*% Rinv %*% A %*% L %*% t(Z_Qtilde)
 B_mat <- cbind(1, xc_eval) %*% solve(crossprod(cbind(1, Qxc))) %*% t(cbind(1, Qxc))
 
 var_vec <- as.numeric((A_mat^2) %*% (D + sig2_est) + 
                        (B_mat^2) %*% (D + sig2_est) + 
                        2 * (A_mat * B_mat) %*% (D + sig2_est))
 
 lower <- f_est - sqrt(var_vec) * qnorm(0.975)
 upper <- f_est + sqrt(var_vec) * qnorm(0.975)
 
 return(list(f_est = f_est, lower = lower, upper = upper, sigma = sqrt(sig2_est)))
}

# Gibbs Approach - Updated For K-Blocks According to ELE Assumption
fit_gibbs <- function(dat, K, n_iter = 1500, burn_in = 500) {
 t0 <- Sys.time()
 
 df <- data.frame(x = dat$x, y = dat$y_obs)
 formula <- y ~ s(x, bs="cr", k=25)
 blocks <- dat$blocks 
 
 gam_naive <- gam(formula, data = df)
 gamobj <- gam(formula, data = df, fit = FALSE)
 
 beta_naive <- as.numeric(coef(gam_naive))
 n <- length(dat$y_obs)
 y <- dat$y_obs
 
 Bgam <- as.matrix(gamobj$X)
 Sgam <- rbind(0, cbind(0, gamobj$smooth[[1]]$S[[1]]))
 
 d <- ncol(Bgam)
 rank_S <- sum(abs(eigen(Sgam, symmetric = TRUE, only.values = TRUE)$values) > 1e-8)
 
 kdeobj <- density(y)
 kdefun <- approxfun(kdeobj$x, kdeobj$y, method = "constant", rule = 2) 
 fy_vals <- pmax(kdefun(y), 1e-10) 
 
 XtX_total <- crossprod(Bgam)
 Xty_total <- crossprod(Bgam, y)
 
 m <- rep(0, n)
 alpha <- rep(0.1, K) 
 beta <- beta_naive
 sigma2 <- var(y) * 0.5
 tau2 <- 1
 
 n_save <- n_iter - burn_in
 samples_beta <- matrix(0, n_save, d)
 samples_alpha <- matrix(0, n_save, K)
 samples_sigma2 <- numeric(n_save)
 samples_tau2 <- numeric(n_save)
 sum_m_probs <- rep(0, n)
 
 n_k <- sapply(1:K, function(k) sum(blocks == k))
 
 # Gibbs Loop
 for (iter in 1:n_iter) {
  
  mu_curr <- as.vector(Bgam %*% beta)
  lik_correct <- dnorm(y, mean = mu_curr, sd = sqrt(sigma2))
  
  prob_prior <- alpha[blocks]
  
  num <- fy_vals * prob_prior
  den <- num + lik_correct * (1 - prob_prior)
  prob_m1 <- num / (den + 1e-300)
  
  m <- rbinom(n, 1, prob_m1)
  
  sum_m_k <- sapply(1:K, function(k) sum(m[blocks == k]))
  alpha <- rbeta(K, 1 + sum_m_k, 1 + n_k - sum_m_k)
  
  idx_m <- which(m == 1)
  XtX_c <- XtX_total
  Xty_c <- Xty_total
  
  if (length(idx_m) > 0) {
   Bm <- Bgam[idx_m, , drop = FALSE]
   ym <- y[idx_m]
   XtX_c <- XtX_c - crossprod(Bm)
   Xty_c <- Xty_c - crossprod(Bm, ym)
  }
  
  Q <- (XtX_c / sigma2) + (Sgam / tau2)
  diag(Q) <- diag(Q) + 1e-6
  
  rhs <- Xty_c / sigma2
  L <- tryCatch(chol(Q), error = function(e) NULL)
  
  if (!is.null(L)) {
   mu_beta <- backsolve(L, forwardsolve(t(L), rhs))
   z <- rnorm(d)
   beta <- mu_beta + backsolve(L, z)
  } else {
   beta <- rep(0, d) 
  }
  
  idx_c <- which(m == 0)
  if (length(idx_c) > 0) {
   resid <- y[idx_c] - as.vector(Bgam[idx_c, , drop = FALSE] %*% beta)
   sse <- sum(resid^2)
   sigma2 <- 1 / rgamma(1, shape = length(idx_c)/2, rate = sse/2)
  }
  
  roughness <- as.numeric(t(beta) %*% Sgam %*% beta)
  tau2 <- 1 / rgamma(1, shape = rank_S/2, rate = roughness/2)
  
  if (iter > burn_in) {
   idx <- iter - burn_in
   samples_beta[idx, ] <- beta
   samples_alpha[idx, ] <- alpha
   samples_sigma2[idx] <- sigma2
   samples_tau2[idx] <- tau2
   sum_m_probs <- sum_m_probs + m
  }
 }
 
 beta_hat <- colMeans(samples_beta)
 alpha_hat <- colMeans(samples_alpha) 
 sigma_hat <- sqrt(mean(samples_sigma2))
 tau2_hat <- mean(samples_tau2)
 m_probs_hat <- sum_m_probs / n_save
 
 X_eval <- predict(gam_naive, newdata = eval_grid, type = "lpmatrix")
 f_est <- as.numeric(X_eval %*% beta_hat)
 
 f_samples <- X_eval %*% t(samples_beta) 
 lower <- apply(f_samples, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025)
 upper <- apply(f_samples, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975)
 
 sigma_ci_lower <- sqrt(quantile(samples_sigma2, 0.025))
 sigma_ci_upper <- sqrt(quantile(samples_sigma2, 0.975))
 
 tau2_ci_lower <- quantile(samples_tau2, 0.025)
 tau2_ci_upper <- quantile(samples_tau2, 0.975)
 
 alpha_ci_lower <- apply(samples_alpha, 2, quantile, probs = 0.025)
 alpha_ci_upper <- apply(samples_alpha, 2, quantile, probs = 0.975)
 
 time_elapsed <- as.numeric(Sys.time() - t0)
 
 return(list(
  f_est = f_est, lower = lower, upper = upper,
  sigma = sigma_hat, sigma_ci_lower = sigma_ci_lower, sigma_ci_upper = sigma_ci_upper,
  alpha = alpha_hat, alpha_ci_lower = alpha_ci_lower, alpha_ci_upper = alpha_ci_upper,
  tau2 = tau2_hat, tau2_ci_lower = tau2_ci_lower, tau2_ci_upper = tau2_ci_upper,
  m_probs = m_probs_hat, time = time_elapsed
 ))
}

# Variational Inference - Updated for K-Blocks According to ELE Asusmption
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
fit_vi <- function(dat, K, maxiter = 100) {
 t0 <- Sys.time()
 
 df <- data.frame(x = dat$x, y = dat$y_obs)
 formula <- y ~ s(x, bs="cr", k=25)
 blocks <- dat$blocks 
 
 gam_naive <- gam(formula, data = df)
 gamobj <- gam(formula, data = df, fit = FALSE)
 
 beta_naive <- coef(gam_naive) 
 n <- length(gam_naive$fitted.values)
 
 Sgam <- rbind(0, cbind(0, gamobj$smooth[[1]]$S[[1]]))
 Bgam <- as.matrix(gamobj$X)
 
 d <- ncol(Bgam)
 d_null <- sum(svd(Sgam)$d < sqrt(.Machine$double.eps))
 dstar <- d - d_null
 
 y <- df$y
 kdeobj <- density(y)
 kdefun <- approxfun(kdeobj$x, kdeobj$y, method = "constant", rule = 2) 
 fy <- kdefun(y)
 
 par_beta <- list(mu = beta_naive, Prec = crossprod(Bgam))
 par_sigmasq <- list(shape = (n - d)/2, rate = sum(residuals(gam_naive)^2)/2)
 par_pi <- list(a = rep(1, K), b = rep(1, K)) 
 par_tausq <- list(shape = dstar/2, rate = sum(beta_naive * (Sgam %*% beta_naive)) / 2)
 
 n_k <- sapply(1:K, function(k) sum(blocks == k))
 
 # Coordinate Ascent Loop
 for(ii in 1:maxiter) {
  
  E_log_pi_a_k <- digamma(par_pi$a) - digamma(par_pi$a + par_pi$b)          
  E_log_pi_b_k <- digamma(par_pi$b) - digamma(par_pi$a + par_pi$b)           
  
  E_log_pi_a_obs <- E_log_pi_a_k[blocks]
  E_log_pi_b_obs <- E_log_pi_b_k[blocks]
  
  log_prob_mm_unnorm <- E_log_pi_a_obs + log(fy)
  
  E_reciproc_sigmasq <- par_sigmasq$shape / par_sigmasq$rate
  E_fit <- Bgam %*% par_beta$mu
  
  invPrec_B <- t(solve(par_beta$Prec, t(Bgam)))
  E_Quad <- rowSums(Bgam * invPrec_B) + (E_fit^2) * E_reciproc_sigmasq
  
  E_log_reciproc_sigmasq <- digamma(par_sigmasq$shape) - log(par_sigmasq$rate)
  log_prob_cm_unnorm <- E_log_pi_b_obs - 0.5*(y^2 - 2*y * E_fit)*E_reciproc_sigmasq - 
   0.5*log(2*pi) + 0.5 * E_log_reciproc_sigmasq - 0.5*E_Quad
  
  logpmax <- pmax(log_prob_mm_unnorm, log_prob_cm_unnorm)
  logsumexp <- logpmax + log(exp(log_prob_mm_unnorm - logpmax) + exp(log_prob_cm_unnorm - logpmax))
  par_m <- exp(log_prob_mm_unnorm - logsumexp)
  
  sum_m_k <- sapply(1:K, function(k) sum(par_m[blocks == k]))
  
  par_pi$a <- 1 + sum_m_k
  par_pi$b <- 1 + n_k - sum_m_k
  
  reg_weights <- 1 - par_m
  Prec_upd <- crossprod(Bgam, sweep(Bgam, MARGIN = 1, STATS = reg_weights, FUN = "*"))
  
  E_reciproc_tausq <- par_tausq$shape / par_tausq$rate
  E_lambda <- (1/E_reciproc_sigmasq) * E_reciproc_tausq       
  Prec_upd <- Prec_upd + E_lambda * Sgam    
  mu_upd <- solve(Prec_upd, crossprod(Bgam, reg_weights * y))
  
  par_beta$Prec <- Prec_upd
  par_beta$mu <- as.numeric(mu_upd)
  
  par_sigmasq$shape <- sum(reg_weights)/2
  invPrec_upd_B <- t(solve(Prec_upd, t(Bgam)))
  trace_term <- rowSums(Bgam * invPrec_upd_B)
  
  par_sigmasq$rate <- sum(reg_weights * ((y - as.numeric(Bgam %*% mu_upd))^2 + 
                                          (1/E_reciproc_sigmasq) * trace_term)) / 2 
  
  par_tausq$rate <- (sum(Sgam * solve(Prec_upd)) * (1/E_reciproc_sigmasq) + 
                      sum(mu_upd * (Sgam %*% mu_upd))) / 2      
 }
 
 Sigma_beta <- solve(par_beta$Prec) * (1 / (par_sigmasq$shape / par_sigmasq$rate)) 
 
 X_eval <- predict(gam_naive, newdata = eval_grid, type = "lpmatrix")
 f_est <- as.numeric(X_eval %*% par_beta$mu)
 
 se_f <- sqrt(rowSums((X_eval %*% Sigma_beta) * X_eval))
 lower <- f_est - 1.96 * se_f
 upper <- f_est + 1.96 * se_f
 
 sigma_est <- sqrt(par_sigmasq$rate / (par_sigmasq$shape - 1))
 tau2_est <- par_tausq$rate / (par_tausq$shape - 1)
 
 alpha_est <- par_pi$a / (par_pi$a + par_pi$b)
 
 sigma_ci_lower <- sqrt(qgamma(0.975, shape=par_sigmasq$shape, rate=par_sigmasq$rate)^-1)
 sigma_ci_upper <- sqrt(qgamma(0.025, shape=par_sigmasq$shape, rate=par_sigmasq$rate)^-1)
 
 tau2_ci_lower <- qgamma(0.975, shape=par_tausq$shape, rate=par_tausq$rate)^-1
 tau2_ci_upper <- qgamma(0.025, shape=par_tausq$shape, rate=par_tausq$rate)^-1
 
 alpha_ci_lower <- qbeta(0.025, par_pi$a, par_pi$b)
 alpha_ci_upper <- qbeta(0.975, par_pi$a, par_pi$b)
 
 time_elapsed <- as.numeric(Sys.time() - t0)
 
 return(list(
  f_est = f_est, lower = lower, upper = upper,
  sigma = sigma_est, sigma_ci_lower = sigma_ci_lower, sigma_ci_upper = sigma_ci_upper,
  alpha = alpha_est, alpha_ci_lower = alpha_ci_lower, alpha_ci_upper = alpha_ci_upper,
  tau2 = tau2_est, tau2_ci_lower = tau2_ci_lower, tau2_ci_upper = tau2_ci_upper,
  m_probs = as.numeric(par_m), time = time_elapsed
 ))
}

# Simulation Worker
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
run_replication <- function(sim_id, param, global_seed) {
 set.seed(global_seed)
 
 dat <- generate_data(param$n, param$sigma, param$K, param$alphas, rep_id = sim_id, global_seed = global_seed)
 sim_dat <- data.frame(x = dat$x, y_obs = dat$y_obs, y_true = dat$y_true, z = dat$z)
 
 res_list <- list()
 
 # Helper function to isolate methods and track failures
 safe_run <- function(name, expr) {
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  tryCatch({
   res <- eval(expr)
   c(list(Method=name), res, list(time=as.numeric(Sys.time()-t0), Failed=0))
  }, error = function(e) {
   list(Method=name, f_est=rep(NA, 200), lower=rep(NA, 200), upper=rep(NA, 200),
        sigma=NA, sigma_ci_lower=NA, sigma_ci_upper=NA,
        alpha=rep(NA, param$K), alpha_ci_lower=rep(NA, param$K), alpha_ci_upper=rep(NA, param$K),
        tau2=NA, tau2_ci_lower=NA, tau2_ci_upper=NA,
        m_probs=rep(NA, length(dat$y_obs)), time=as.numeric(Sys.time()-t0), Failed=1)
  })
 }
 
 # Oracle Baseline
 res_list[[1]] <- safe_run("Oracle", {
  fit <- gam(y_true ~ s(x, bs="cr", k=25), data = sim_dat, method="REML")
  p <- predict(fit, newdata = eval_grid, se.fit=TRUE)
  list(f_est=p$fit, lower=p$fit - 1.96*p$se.fit, upper=p$fit + 1.96*p$se.fit)
 })
 
 # Naive Baseline
 res_list[[2]] <- safe_run("Naive", {
  fit <- gam(y_obs ~ s(x, bs="cr", k=25), data = sim_dat, method="REML")
  p <- predict(fit, newdata = eval_grid, se.fit=TRUE)
  list(f_est=p$fit, lower=p$fit - 1.96*p$se.fit, upper=p$fit + 1.96*p$se.fit)
 })
 
 # ELE Adjustment Strategies
 ele_strategies <- list("ELE_n1_5" = param$n^(1/5), "ELE_n1_2" = param$n^(1/2), "ELE_GCV" = "GCV", "ELE_REML" = "REML")
 idx <- 3
 for (strat_name in names(ele_strategies)) {
  res_list[[idx]] <- safe_run(strat_name, { fit_ele(dat, param$K, param$alphas, sp_choice = ele_strategies[[strat_name]], sigma_true = param$sigma, eval_grid = eval_grid) })
  idx <- idx + 1
 }
 
 # Gibbs Sampler
 res_list[[idx]] <- safe_run("Gibbs", { fit_gibbs(dat, param$K) })
 idx <- idx + 1
 
 # Variational Inference
 res_list[[idx]] <- safe_run("VB", { fit_vi(dat, param$K) })
 
 # Compile Metrics
 fit_oracle_true <- gam(y_true ~ s(x, bs="cr", k=25), data = sim_dat, method="REML")
 oracle_beta <- coef(fit_oracle_true)
 Sgam_oracle <- rbind(0, cbind(0, fit_oracle_true$smooth[[1]]$S[[1]]))
 # true_tau2 using the Oracle fit to align with mgcv's internal penalty scaling
 # The penalty matrix rank for bs="cr" with k=25 is 23
 true_tau2 <- as.numeric(t(oracle_beta) %*% Sgam_oracle %*% oracle_beta) / 23
 
 metrics <- lapply(res_list, function(res) {
  if (res$Failed == 1) {
   df_base <- data.frame(
    n = param$n, sigma_true = param$sigma, K = param$K, Alpha_Setting = paste(param$alphas, collapse = "_"), 
    Method = res$Method, RMSE = NA, Coverage = NA, Bias_Sigma = NA, Cov_Sigma = NA,
    Bias_Alpha_1 = NA, Cov_Alpha_1 = NA, Bias_Alpha_2 = NA, Cov_Alpha_2 = NA,
    Bias_Alpha_3 = NA, Cov_Alpha_3 = NA, Bias_Alpha_4 = NA, Cov_Alpha_4 = NA,
    Tau2_Est = NA, Bias_Tau2 = NA, Cov_Tau2 = NA, Time = res$time, Failed = 1
   )
   pt_df <- as.data.frame(t(rep(NA, 200)))
   colnames(pt_df) <- paste0("pt_cov_", 1:200)
   return(cbind(df_base, pt_df))
  }
  
  # Get a 200-point logical vector for true point-wise coverage tracking
  rmse <- sqrt(mean((res$f_est - true_f_eval)^2))
  pt_coverage <- as.numeric(res$lower <= true_f_eval & res$upper >= true_f_eval)
  coverage_mean <- mean(pt_coverage, na.rm=TRUE)
  
  bias_sigma <- if (!is.null(res$sigma)) res$sigma - param$sigma else NA
  cov_sigma <- if (!is.null(res$sigma_ci_lower)) as.numeric(param$sigma >= res$sigma_ci_lower & param$sigma <= res$sigma_ci_upper) else NA
  
  bias_alpha <- rep(NA, 4); cov_alpha <- rep(NA, 4)
  if (!is.null(res$alpha)) {
   for (k in 1:param$K) {
    bias_alpha[k] <- res$alpha[k] - param$alphas[k]
    if (!is.null(res$alpha_ci_lower)) cov_alpha[k] <- as.numeric(param$alphas[k] >= res$alpha_ci_lower[k] & param$alphas[k] <= res$alpha_ci_upper[k])
   }
  }
  
  tau2_est <- if(!is.null(res$tau2)) res$tau2 else NA
  bias_tau2 <- if(!is.null(res$tau2)) res$tau2 - true_tau2 else NA
  cov_tau2 <- if(!is.null(res$tau2_ci_lower)) as.numeric(true_tau2 >= res$tau2_ci_lower & true_tau2 <= res$tau2_ci_upper) else NA
  
  df_base <- data.frame(
   n = param$n, sigma_true = param$sigma, K = param$K, Alpha_Setting = paste(param$alphas, collapse = "_"), 
   Method = res$Method, RMSE = rmse, Coverage = coverage_mean, Bias_Sigma = bias_sigma, Cov_Sigma = cov_sigma,
   Bias_Alpha_1 = bias_alpha[1], Cov_Alpha_1 = cov_alpha[1], Bias_Alpha_2 = bias_alpha[2], Cov_Alpha_2 = cov_alpha[2],
   Bias_Alpha_3 = bias_alpha[3], Cov_Alpha_3 = cov_alpha[3], Bias_Alpha_4 = bias_alpha[4], Cov_Alpha_4 = cov_alpha[4],
   Tau2_Est = tau2_est, Bias_Tau2 = bias_tau2, Cov_Tau2 = cov_tau2, Time = res$time, Failed = 0
  )
  pt_df <- as.data.frame(t(pt_coverage))
  colnames(pt_df) <- paste0("pt_cov_", 1:200)
  cbind(df_base, pt_df)
 })
 do.call(rbind, metrics)
}

# Perform Replications
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
task_env <- Sys.getenv("SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID")

if (task_env == "") {
 cat("\n Local Test (1 replication) \n")
 test_sigmas <- c(0.1, 0.25, 0.75, 1.0, 1.25)
 for (sig in test_sigmas) {
  cat(sprintf("\n sigma = %.2f, alpha = 0.3, n = 500 \n", sig))
  test_param <- list(n = 500, sigma = sig, K = 1, alphas = 0.3)
  t_start <- Sys.time()
  
  success <- FALSE
  attempt <- 0
  while(!success) {
   attempt <- attempt + 1
   test_res <- run_replication(sim_id = 999 + attempt, param = test_param, global_seed = 12345 + attempt)
   if (sum(test_res$Failed) == 0) {
    success <- TRUE
   } else {
    cat(sprintf("Method(s) %s crashed.\n", paste(test_res$Method[test_res$Failed == 1], collapse=", ")))
   }
  }
  
  t_end <- Sys.time()
  formatted <- as.data.frame(t(test_res))
  colnames(formatted) <- formatted["Method", ]
  formatted <- formatted[!(rownames(formatted) %in% c("Method", "n", "sigma_true", "K")), ]
  formatted[] <- lapply(formatted, function(x) { num_x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x)); ifelse(is.na(num_x), x, round(num_x, 4)) })
  print(formatted[c("RMSE", "Coverage", "Failed"), ])
  cat(sprintf(" Time: %.2f sec\n", as.numeric(t_end - t_start, units="secs")))
 }
} else {
 task_id <- as.integer(task_env)
 TASKS_PER_SCENARIO <- 10
 REPS_PER_TASK <- 100
 
 scenario_idx <- ((task_id - 1) %/% TASKS_PER_SCENARIO) + 1
 chunk_idx <- ((task_id - 1) %% TASKS_PER_SCENARIO) + 1
 current_param <- scenarios[[scenario_idx]]
 
 start_rep <- (chunk_idx - 1) * REPS_PER_TASK + 1
 end_rep <- chunk_idx * REPS_PER_TASK
 
 cat(sprintf("Task %d: Scenario %d (n=%d, sigma=%.2f, K=%d) | Replications %d to %d\n", 
             task_id, scenario_idx, current_param$n, current_param$sigma, current_param$K, start_rep, end_rep))
 
 chunk_results <- list()
 successful_reps <- 0
 attempt <- 0
 
 # Loop until we get REPS_PER_TASK datasets where all methods work
 while (successful_reps < REPS_PER_TASK) {
  attempt <- attempt + 1
  current_rep_id <- start_rep + attempt - 1
  unique_seed <- scenario_idx * 100000 + current_rep_id 
  
  res_df <- run_replication(sim_id = current_rep_id, param = current_param, global_seed = unique_seed)
  
  if (sum(res_df$Failed) == 0) {
   chunk_results[[length(chunk_results) + 1]] <- res_df
   successful_reps <- successful_reps + 1
  } else {
   failed_rows <- res_df[res_df$Failed == 1, ]
   chunk_results[[length(chunk_results) + 1]] <- failed_rows
   cat(sprintf("Attempt %d failed for %s.\n", attempt, paste(failed_rows$Method, collapse=", ")))
  }
 }
 
 final_chunk_data <- do.call(rbind, chunk_results)
 out_dir <- "sim_results"
 if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
 out_file <- file.path(out_dir, sprintf("res_scen_%02d_chunk_%02d.rds", scenario_idx, chunk_idx))
 saveRDS(final_chunk_data, out_file)
}
```
